steps.summary: Completed on 'fwgr57-n3 Bench Dashboard Bench Dashboard' (UID cfyk0oye128e8e): the top-bar refresh interval dropdown (previously 'Off') was opened and '1m' selected, and the picker immediately reported the current interval as 1 minute. The dashboard was then saved — the Save dashboard drawer showed Details/Changes1 tabs and initially reported no changes with Save disabled, so 'Update default refresh value — Will make the current refresh the new default' was ticked, which produced the Changes1 tab and enabled Save; Save clicked with no error. A fresh load of the dashboard URL confirmed the top-bar refresh dropdown reads '1m' as the selected interval, and the address bar reads exactly http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfyk0oye128e8e/fwgr57-n3-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m. Both panels are displayed: 'fwgr57-n3 Bench Dashboard Notes' and 'fwgr57-n3 Bench Dashboard Availability'.
